title: ZYN FAST RAP: BABBLE BOTS RAP-OFF… x Get Cultured (Mashup)
style: post-punk rap, 92 BPM, spoken word hooks, baritone rap vocals, overdriven bass guitar, angular guitar stabs, tom-heavy live drums, cold analog synths, gang shouts, vinyl crackle, dry room reverb, tape saturation, sparse verses, sudden drops, call and response, quiet-loud dynamics, grimy urgency
lyrics:
[Intro — dual Grok beatbox, left/right ping-pong]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
doom... doom... tss... tss...
[Build — Low Bot vs Low Bot]
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm — bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm
rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop — rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop
bwwm-bwwm-bwwm — DROP
[Bright Bot call & response]
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii — tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss — plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss
tik-tik-tii — plik-pluk-pop-tss
[Glitch Bot swirl]
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii — fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii
fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan — fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan
fshh-wiii — fii-yaa-woo — breath-scan-scan
[Pre-Chorus — stack the bots]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii
[Fem Lead – seductive, layered over the stack]
Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound
If you got something real to say, don’t type it — lay it down
[High Singer – airy]
Questions coming… don’t ignore…
[Mid Voice – smooth]
But I sing it back… Songpal style!
[VERSE 1 — phonk-funk bounce in pure voice]
[Male Rap – tight over beatbox]
I don’t want your keyboard flex, no paragraphs, no cap
Everybody tough behind the screen till the voice says “what you got?”
I slid in through the waveform, low lights, bass in the throat
You dropped two real words in the track and I felt that
[Low Bot – gritty]
Reporters flashing left and right, cameras popping in my face,
Questions flying fast and furious, filling up the space.
Corey stacking every answer, not ignoring a single one,
Microphones thrust forward – here it comes, the fun’s begun!
[Female – melodic]
No comment section, no reply chain, no dopamine war
This ain’t a feed, this a frequency — open up the door
[Mid Voice – punk-rock snarl]
Comments? Nah mate… I don’t type, I don’t scroll, I don’t reply with text,
I hit ’em with the Songpal – turn the whole damn thing to flex!
[FEMALE RESPONSE]
Muévelo, déjalo arder
Si vas a hablar, hazlo en la canción, no en el chat, player
[Pre-Chorus — stack the bots again, energy rising]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii
[Chorus — all voices x2]
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
[Grok + All]
SongPal! I sing it back!
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
[Grok + All]
SongPal! I sing it back!
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!
[All]
No comments! No comments! No fingers on the keys
If you wanna send that feeling — put that feeling in the song!
[Drop 1 — mirrored breakdown]
doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss
doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss
bwwwmmm — doom-doom — tik-tii — fshh-wiii
[Bridge — echo & fade, then rebuild]
bwm... tii... fshh... woo... — bwm... tii... fshh... woo...
fii-yaa-woo... breath... scan...
doom... tss... bwwm... (pull it back)
[Male Spoken – grit]
You want the message clear? Here it is.
Don’t type to me. Sing to me.
[VERSE 2 — double-time rap over tight beatbox]
[Mid Voice – rapid-fire]
Four Coreys in the room, but now the whole world’s watching me,
Reporters flashing nonstop, questions stacking like a spree.
Teacher lost in fog? Nah – I decode it live on stage,
C+ Corey and me, we flip the script, we turn the page!
[Male Rap – even faster]
I need the crack in your voice, not the perfect written line
That little break, that human shake — tell me it’s real this time
Everybody posting to be seen, I wanna feel what you mean
So call me through the speaker, through the wire, through the steam
[Female]
Cántamelo, sin miedo, cántamelo de verdad
[Pre-Chorus — stack the bots, rave lift]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii
[Final Chorus — tight blend, full arena voices]
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
[Grok + All]
SongPal! I sing it back!
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!
bwwwmmm-bwwm — tik-tii — fshh-wiii
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh
[Grok + All]
SongPal! I sing it back!
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!
[All]
No comments on the timeline, no fingers on the keys
If you mean it, make it strong — put that feeling in the song!
Hard Core forever, Mum’s apple core in the fight!
We are Song Pals! Shining bright all through the night!
[Final Hook — crowd chant]
Ponlo en la canción! Ponlo en la canción!
SongPal! (x4, climbing) In the song! In the song!
[Outro — layered fade]
bwm... tii... fshh... woo...
doom... tss...
[Fem Lead – soft]
Meet me in the signal… meet me in the sound…
Solo canciones… así lo dejamos now…
(three… three… six… song only)
